title: cliEval run summary
description: Schema for `summary.json` written by the cliEval Reporter. Roadmap DM-012 / Deliverable D-0053. Producer: `superclaude.cli.eval.models.RunSummary.to_dict()` (T03.09). Writer: `write_aggregated_report` (FR-RPT1 / T03.11). Fidelity test: TEST-007 (T04.17). `len(evals[]) == counts.expanded_n_prime` is enforced by FR-RPT1 outside this schema; the schema documents the required field shape, not the invariant.

run_id.description: Opaque identifier the orchestrator stamps on the run. Stable across artifacts so reviewers can join per-eval JSONL logs against the aggregate summary.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 wall-clock timestamp marking the orchestrator start.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 wall-clock timestamp marking the orchestrator stop. Optional: may be empty for partial summaries written on SIGINT before the orchestrator completed.

duration_sec.description: Wall-clock seconds the orchestrator ran end to end.

suite.description: Manifest path / suite identifier the orchestrator loaded.

manifest_version.description: Semantic version stamped on the manifest at author time.

parallel.description: Concurrency level the orchestrator scheduled at (post-clamp to [1,15]).

evals.description: Per-expanded-eval outcomes (DM-001 / T03.01). FR-RPT1 (T03.11) enforces `len(evals[]) == counts.expanded_n_prime` outside this schema.

artifacts.description: Artifact-name → path map the orchestrator emits (JSONL directory, disk-budget breach side-car, ...). Optional.

evalStatus.description: DM-001 EvalStatus literal set. Must match `superclaude.cli.eval.models.EVAL_STATUSES` verbatim.

manifest_n.description: Number of rows in the source manifest before parameterize expansion.

expanded_n_prime.description: Number of expanded eval rows after parameterize expansion. Ground-truth row count for FR-RPT1 (T03.11).

kept_k.description: Number of expanded rows that ran end-to-end.

skipped_s.description: Number of expanded rows that were skipped (SKIPPED or INTERRUPTED).

kept_plus_skipped_equals_n_prime.description: DM-012 boolean assertion that `kept_k + skipped_s == expanded_n_prime`. `RunSummary.__post_init__` enforces the flag mirrors the math.

runTotals.description: DM-012 totals sub-structure (T03.09 `RunTotals`). The six status tallies the Reporter renders in the summary headline.

evalOutcome.description: DM-001 EvalOutcome serialised by `EvalOutcome.to_dict()` (T03.01). Field shape matches `_EVAL_OUTCOME_FIELDS` verbatim.

eval_id.description: Id of the expanded eval (FR-SCH2 regex-guarded upstream).

title.description: Human-readable eval title copied from EvalSpec.

duration_sec.description: Wall-clock seconds the eval ran. 0.0 for SKIPPED outcomes.

expects.description: ExpectResult records (DM-009 / T01.15), one per evaluated assertion. Empty for SKIPPED.

skip_reason.description: Free-form reason string when status is SKIPPED. Null otherwise.

skip_flag_triggered.description: Name of the flag/capability that triggered the skip. Null when not flag-driven.

artifacts.description: Artifact-name → path map produced by the eval. Empty for SKIPPED.

error_class.description: Fully-qualified Python exception class name when status is ERRORED. Null otherwise.
